learning_objective: 🏸 Get ready to swing your racket, serve the shuttlecock high into the air, and have a super fun badminton rally with your friends!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Hold your racket handle just like you are shaking hands with a friend. Keep your wrist loose and flexible so you can swing fast and hit the shuttlecock hard!
To start the game, hold the shuttlecock by the feathers, drop it gently, and strike it from below your waist. Send it flying high over the net!
Always keep your eyes on the shuttlecock as it floats in the air. Move your feet quickly to get under it, reach up high, and tap it back to your partner.

fun_activity.title: 🎈 Balloon Badminton Fun
fun_activity.instructions: Blow up a balloon and use a racket or your bare hands to keep it in the air! Count how many times you can strike it upwards before it touches the floor.

quick_recap: ⭐ Hold the racket loosely like a handshake for the best swing power.
⭐ Serve the shuttlecock from below your waist to start the fun rally.
⭐ Keep your eyes focused on the shuttlecock the whole time it is flying.
